Registry of Deeds records tax instruments for all communities. Investor opportunity is municipal surplus real estate auctions, highly local calendars.

34001.notes: New Jersey municipal tax-lien system (N.J.S.A. 54:5). Atlantic County does not hold one countywide tax sale — each municipality (Atlantic City, Egg Harbor Township, Galloway, Hamilton, Pleasantville, etc.) runs its own annual tax sale for delinquent taxes, water/sewer, and municipal charges. Typical format is bid-down from 18% interest; at 0% bidders may bid premium. Certificate is not a deed; private holders generally wait 2 years then file Superior Court foreclosure of the right of redemption. Many towns use RealAuction/newjerseytaxsale.com online platforms (e.g. Atlantic City Dec 2025 online sale). County Board of Taxation maintains assessor/collector contact lists.

34001.depositRules: Set by each municipal tax collector and platform: pre-register, post any required deposit, fund winning certificates by ACH/certified funds deadline. Premium handling per N.J.S.A. 54:5. Redeem/cancel certificates via municipal collector and record with Atlantic County Clerk.

37021.notes: North Carolina judicial tax foreclosure county (no over-the-counter tax liens). Buncombe County Tax Collections uses in rem (§105-375) and mortgage-style (§105-374) foreclosures as last-resort collection. Sales held on front steps of county courthouse by commissioner; advertised in newspaper of general circulation. Opening bid announced at sale; deposit up to 20% of bid due after sale; balance after 10-day upset-bid period and confirmation. Upset bids filed with Clerk of Superior Court — must exceed current bid by 5% or $750 (whichever greater) with deposit of 5% of new high bid (min $750) by cash/certified/cashier's check. Official bids tracked at Clerk (828-259-3400); online map listing is courtesy only.

Upset bid: deposit 5% of new bid (min $750) with Clerk of Superior Court by cash or certified/cashier's check. Call Clerk 828-259-3400 for official bid status. Sales AS IS without warranty; may be subject to additional taxes/assessments not in judgment.
